concept: Arrow Mouse Cursor with Long Tail
description: A broad pointer aims toward the upper left, with an elongated triangular head and a stepped inward notch. A short rectangular tail projects diagonally down and right from the head.

concept: Single Eyed Rounded Creature Head
description: A rounded upright creature head has a domed top, straight sides, and small semicircular ears. One large almond shaped eye with a round pupil sits centrally across the otherwise blank face.

concept: Straight Leg Jeans with Curved Pockets
description: A pair of jeans faces forward beneath a wide horizontal waistband. Curved pocket openings sit at either hip, with a central fly above two straight legs separated by a tapered gap.

concept: Curved Palm Tree Between Sand Dunes
description: A slender palm trunk curves upward from a low sand dune to a crown of spreading arched fronds. Another rolling dune passes behind the trunk across the middle of the scene.

concept: Pointed Paper Plane Silhouette
description: A paper plane points diagonally toward the upper right with a long sloping leading edge and rounded nose. An inward notch along the lower edge separates its two unequal rear corners.

concept: Rounded Deodorant Stick with Blank Label
description: An upright deodorant stick has a domed cap separated from the body by a horizontal seam. A small rounded rectangular label sits centrally on the otherwise blank lower container.

concept: Low Lounger with Angled Backrest
description: A long reclining lounger has an angled raised backrest at its left end and a flat seat extending right. Two short slanted legs support its slim horizontal base beneath the cushion.

concept: Arrow Right Beside Dashed Vertical Guide
description: A horizontal arrow points right with two long diagonal arms forming an open head. A separate dashed vertical guide stands to its left, leaving a clear gap before the shaft begins.

concept: Arrow Dashed Right Angle Descent
description: A dashed shaft runs horizontally from the left and turns down through a small rounded corner. Separate vertical segments lead toward an open downward arrowhead at the lower right.

concept: Arrow Right Return with Broken Lower Shaft
description: A long line curves around the left in a broad U turn and returns toward the right below itself. A gap interrupts the lower shaft before its open right pointing head.

concept: Arrow Right Return with Tall Rounded Bend
description: A continuous shaft begins near the upper right, curves broadly down around the left, and returns right along the bottom. Two diagonal arms form a large open head at the lower endpoint.

concept: Arrow Rising Through Square Right Turn
description: A vertical shaft rises from the lower left and turns sharply right at a square elbow. Its horizontal upper section ends in a large open arrowhead with long diagonal arms.

concept: Arrow Right Return with Wide Upper Run
description: A horizontal upper shaft enters a broad rounded bend on the left and returns along a lower horizontal run. The lower endpoint carries a small open arrowhead pointing right.

concept: Arrow Right Return with Level Parallel Runs
description: Two long horizontal runs join around a broad curved left end, forming a sideways U. The lower run extends to a right pointing open head beneath the upper run's endpoint.

concept: Arrow Rising Step with Broken Start
description: A short detached dash leads into a line that rounds upward through a vertical step. The line curves right again at the top and ends in an open right pointing arrowhead.

concept: Round Fruit with Large Pointed Leaf
description: A round fruit hangs below a short angled stem and one large leaf extending toward the upper right. The leaf has a pointed tip and a single diagonal vein inside.

concept: Three Lobed Crown with Round Finial
description: A royal crown has three tall rounded lobes rising from a broad tapered band. The central lobe stands highest beneath a small detached round finial, with matching outer lobes on either side.

concept: Radiating Dandelion Seed Head
description: A slender curved stem rises to a central junction of long radiating seed stalks. Uneven straight spokes spread in every direction, with one small hooked end visible on the right.

concept: Closed Envelope with Diagonal Back Seam
description: A closed rectangular envelope has softly rounded lower corners and a large triangular flap descending from its upper corners. Another diagonal seam runs from beneath the flap toward the lower right corner.

concept: Gabled House with Plain Doorway
description: A small house faces forward beneath a steep triangular roof with projecting eaves. A tall plain rectangular doorway stands centrally in the otherwise blank facade and meets the bottom edge.

concept: Pouch with Two Rounded Tie Ends
description: A broad pouch widens toward a rounded rectangular base and narrows at its upper shoulders. Two tall rounded tie ends rise from the top, separated by a short recessed central notch.

concept: Birdhouse with Round Entrance and Perch
description: A small birdhouse has a pointed gabled roof over a box with rounded lower corners. A circular entrance sits below the roof, and a short straight perch extends beneath the base.

concept: Ink Bottle with Ribbed Cap and Label
description: A squat ink bottle has curved shoulders beneath a wide ribbed screw cap. Two horizontal lines bound a broad label band, with a short central stroke marking its otherwise blank face.

concept: Smiling Devil Bust with Curved Horns
description: A round faced devil has two pointed horns curving upward from the sides of its head. A small curved smile sits low on the face above a broad arched shoulder outline.

concept: Square Culvert with Arched Opening
description: A square masonry outline surrounds a wide central opening that rises into a semicircular arch. Two straight side piers descend to a shared baseline, leaving the middle passage open below.

concept: Arrow Rising Through Rounded Step
description: A continuous shaft begins horizontally at the lower left and curves upward through a tall vertical section. A second rounded bend leads right into an open arrowhead at the top.

concept: Stylized Wing with Four Rounded Feathers
description: A single wing slants upward to the right with a smooth rising leading edge and flat upper edge. Four rounded feather ends step downward along the opposite side toward the base.

concept: Sun Appearing Behind Rounded Hill
description: A small sun rises behind a broad semicircular hill resting on a straight baseline. Short rays extend above and beside the visible upper half of the sun in a balanced arrangement.

concept: Straight Hem Stage Curtains Drawn Apart
description: Two tall curtains hang from a shared straight top edge and gather toward opposite sides at mid height. Curving inner edges open onto a blank center above straight horizontal lower hems.

concept: Tooth Beside Bent Dental Stick
description: A broad two rooted tooth stands behind a long diagonal dental stick. The stick has a rounded lower end and a short hooked upper tip that bends back toward the tooth.

concept: Large Tooth Beside Upright Toothbrush
description: A large molar has a shallow dip across its crown and two long rounded roots. An upright toothbrush stands to the right, with short horizontal bristle lines projecting toward the tooth.

concept: Angled Toothbrush Above Small Molar
description: A toothbrush crosses diagonally above a two rooted molar, with its bristle head hanging beneath the left end. The tooth's rounded crown dips centrally above its deeply separated roots.

concept: Dhow with Curved Triangular Sail
description: A dhow floats on a wavy waterline beneath a single tall triangular sail with curved sides. A short central mast joins the sail to a shallow hull with raised pointed ends.

concept: Arrow Twin Upward Ends on U Curve
description: A broad U shaped line curves across the bottom and rises vertically on both sides. Each upper endpoint carries an open upward arrowhead, forming a balanced pair around the empty center.

concept: Arrow Up Above Two Horizontal Bars
description: A broad outlined arrow points upward with a triangular head and two open shaft edges. Two separate horizontal bars sit beneath its tail, extending farther sideways than the shaft.

concept: Arrow Rising into Rounded Right Turn
description: A long vertical shaft rises from the lower left into a smooth rounded elbow. Its upper horizontal run extends right and ends in a small open arrowhead with two diagonal arms.

concept: Profile Bust with Square Lower Corners
description: A featureless round head sits above a broad shoulder outline with a flat base. The shoulders curve into straight upright sides, meeting the bottom edge at distinct square corners.

concept: Arrow Down After Two Opposing Bends
description: A line descends on the left, rounds upward from a deep lower bend, and arches over at the top. Its rightmost vertical section ends in an open downward arrowhead.

concept: Arrow Down with Angular Zigzag Shaft
description: A short vertical line turns right before running diagonally down and left through an angular zigzag. A second horizontal step leads into the final downward shaft and open arrowhead.

concept: Clock with Four Marks and Round Hub
description: A circular clock face carries short marks at its four cardinal positions. Two hands extend from a round central hub toward the upper right and lower right across the otherwise blank face.

concept: Round Four Hole Disk with Outer Rim
description: A circular disk has a broad outer rim surrounding a recessed round center. Four small circular holes occupy the center in a balanced diamond arrangement, with clear spacing between them.

concept: Three Rounded Network Nodes
description: Three rounded square nodes connect through a central junction, with one node above two lower nodes. A vertical stem descends from the upper node to the horizontal link between the lower pair.

concept: Domed Diaphragm with Thick Lower Rim
description: A rounded diaphragm dome rises above a thick horizontal rim with softened corners. A smaller curved arch sits inside the dome, following its shape while stopping short of the lower rim.

concept: Curled Dragon with Two Small Horns
description: A serpentine dragon faces right with a blunt projecting snout and two short horns. Its thick neck winds into an S curve above a broad curled body and pointed raised tail.

concept: Laptop Worker Beside Beach Palm
description: A round headed person sits behind an open laptop shown as a slanted panel with a circular mark. A small palm tree rises from a wavy shoreline at the upper left.

concept: Dining Table with Single Side Chair
description: A rectangular dining table stands on two straight legs beside a single chair on the left. The chair has a tall slightly sloping back and a narrow seat facing the table.

concept: Director Chair Beneath Large Megaphone
description: A large megaphone points right above a folding director chair, with a small grip beneath its flared body. The chair's flat seat rests on crossed supports between short upright side posts.

concept: Diaper with Curved Side Tabs
description: A disposable diaper has a broad straight waistband and a curved lower edge. Rounded fastening tabs reach inward from both sides, while curved seams define the two lower leg openings.

concept: Diving Mask Snorkel and Fish Set
description: A broad diving mask sits above a fish facing right, with a long snorkel curving downward beside the mask. The snorkel ends in a round mouthpiece between the mask and fish.

concept: Dog Leaping Over Triangular Obstacle
description: A dog leaps toward the right with its front legs stretched forward and hind legs extended behind. Its thin tail curves upward above a separate triangular obstacle beneath the body.

concept: Chevron Double Down with Wide Arms
description: Two wide V shaped chevrons stack vertically with matching diagonal arms. Both point downward around a shared centerline, leaving a broad open gap between the upper and lower marks.

concept: Dragon Boat with Diagonal Paddle
description: A long boat has a raised dragon head at the left and an upturned pointed stern at the right. A paddle crosses diagonally over the hull with its blade extending below.

concept: Bent Drainpipe with Falling Water Lines
description: A broad pipe bends downward through a rounded elbow and ends in a thick horizontal outlet rim. Three separate vertical water lines descend beneath the opening with gaps between them.

concept: Left Facing Duck with Folded Wing
description: A duck faces left with a long flat bill and small eye above a curved neck. Its rounded body carries a large folded wing that tapers toward the raised tail at the right.

concept: Upright Two Pin Plug with Curled Cable
description: An electrical plug has two straight pins rising from a broad body with a rounded lower edge. A cable leaves the bottom center and curves down before turning upward to the right.

concept: Oil Dipstick with Rounded End Grips
description: A slender upright dipstick joins two narrow rounded end pieces. Two short horizontal level marks project from the right side of the central stem, spaced between the upper and lower ends.

concept: Plain Door in Broad Rounded Frame
description: A tall closed door sits inside a broad frame with rounded upper corners. A small round knob appears on the right side of the door above a long horizontal threshold line.

concept: Front Facing Doe with Large Ears
description: A doe faces forward with two large pointed ears spreading above its narrow face. Tiny eyes and a rounded nose sit above the tapered muzzle, while the neck extends downward.

concept: Dove Flying Right with Raised Wing
description: A dove flies toward the right with a pointed beak and curved chest. One large wing rises diagonally toward the upper left, while a broad tail fans out behind and below.

concept: Upright Fork and Rounded Table Knife
description: A fork and knife stand side by side with their handles below. The fork has three long tines, while the knife has a curved blade that narrows into its rounded handle.

concept: Low Racing Car with Raised Rear Wing
description: A low racing car faces left with two exposed round wheels, a pointed nose, and an angular cockpit. A rectangular rear wing sits above the right wheel on a short upright support.

concept: Four Rounded Petals Around Small Center
description: A flower has four broad rounded petals extending upward, downward, left, and right around a small central disk. Narrow inward notches separate the petals near the middle of the blossom.

concept: Dragon Fruit with Pointed Crown and Speckles
description: An upright dragon fruit has a broad rounded lower body narrowing toward a crown of three pointed tips. Small scattered marks dot its otherwise blank surface beneath the curved shoulders.

concept: Dog Face with Drooping Ears and Tongue
description: A friendly dog faces forward with broad drooping ears on either side of its head. Tiny eyes sit above a rounded nose, divided muzzle, and small tongue visible beneath.

concept: Fuel Pump with Hanging Side Hose
description: A tall rounded fuel pump has a blank rectangular display near its top. A hose emerges from the right side, loops downward, and rises to a narrow angled nozzle beside the pump.

concept: Pointed Garden Trowel with Rounded Handle
description: A hand trowel lies diagonally from lower left to upper right, with a broad triangular blade tapering to a rounded point. A short shaft joins the blade to an elongated rounded handle.

concept: Diagonal Shovel with Broad D Grip
description: A shovel lies diagonally with its broad rounded blade at the lower left and D shaped grip at the upper right. A long straight shaft extends between and into both parts.

concept: Tilting Hand Truck with Square Load
description: A hand truck tilts to the right beneath a rounded rectangular load. Its tall handle rises on the left, and a sloping lower support connects a large rear wheel to a smaller front wheel.

concept: Cuffed Hands Supporting Faceted Diamond
description: Two upturned hands with rectangular cuffs frame a faceted diamond above their palms. The diamond has a flat top, broad shoulders, and a pointed lower tip divided by diagonal facet lines.

concept: Overlapping Hands Surrounding Small Heart
description: Two overlapping hands form a broad rounded outer silhouette with fingers crossing along the lower edge. A small detached heart sits centrally inside the blank upper area enclosed by the hands.

concept: Hanging Disco Ball with Curved Grid
description: A round disco ball hangs from a short vertical cord. Horizontal bands cross its surface, while two opposing curved vertical lines divide the sphere into a broad central strip and side sections.

concept: Ear with Broken Diagonal and Outer Arc
description: An ear outline curves around an inner fold beside three short diagonal strokes approaching from the lower left. A separate curved arc sits beyond the ear at the upper right.

concept: Open Hands Beneath Floating Heart
description: Two open hands face inward beneath a large symmetrical heart. Upright outer fingers and bent thumbs form a cupped gesture, leaving a clear gap between the palms and the heart's pointed base.

concept: Wheeled Excavator with Raised Jointed Boom
description: A wheeled excavator has a small cab above a rounded body and two separate circular wheels. Its jointed boom rises diagonally to the right before descending into a curved digging bucket.

concept: Ear with Round Hearing Device and Waves
description: An ear contains a round hearing device joined to a curved inner fitting. Two separate sound wave arcs sit to the right of the outer ear, which curves into a rounded lobe below.

concept: Plain Dishwasher with Upper Panel Division
description: A tall dishwasher has a plain rounded rectangular front divided by a horizontal line near the top. The upper control panel and larger lower door are both blank within the outer outline.

concept: Girl Doll with Bob Hair and Dress
description: A small doll faces forward with a rounded bob hairstyle framing a blank face. Short rounded arms extend beside a flared dress, with two short rounded legs projecting below the hem.

concept: Long Necked Dinosaur with Two Visible Legs
description: A dinosaur faces right with a long upright neck, small rounded head, and broad arched body. Two short blocky legs support it below, while a pointed tail slopes down toward the left.

concept: Rounded Armchair with Inset Seat Cushion
description: A broad armchair faces forward with a tall rounded back and thick rounded arms. A separate seat cushion sits between the arms above a continuous lower base and two short straight legs.

concept: Round Doorknob on Tall Backplate
description: A large round doorknob projects from the upper half of a tall rounded rectangular backplate. A smaller circular fitting sits below it, and the knob overlaps the plate's right edge.

concept: Chip Dipped into Mounded Sauce Bowl
description: A broad bowl contains a rounded mound of dip rising above its straight rim. A single tilted chip enters from the upper right, with its lower corner touching the dip near the rim.

concept: Drawbridge Between Rounded Upright Posts
description: Two tall rounded posts flank a narrow horizontal bridge deck. A single diagonal support line climbs from the deck's left end toward the upper part of the right post.

concept: Open Drapes with Curved Lower Hems
description: Two curtains hang from a shared top edge and gather toward opposite sides around mid height. Their curved inner edges reveal a wide empty opening, while gently curved hems close the panels below.

concept: Crested Dinosaur in Left Facing Profile
description: A crested dinosaur faces left with an elongated snout and a narrow crest sweeping back above its head. Its curved body carries short forelimbs, a bent hind leg, and a pointed trailing tail.

concept: Person Beside Toilet and Detached Circle
description: A standing person extends one arm toward a side view toilet on the left. A large detached circle floats above the toilet, while a tiny dot sits between the hand and bowl.

concept: Dog Walker Carrying Hanging Bag
description: A standing person holds a leash leading to a small right facing dog and carries a hanging bag in the other hand. The dog has pointed ears, a long body, and short legs.

concept: Profile Person Wearing Slanted Beret
description: A person faces right with a projecting nose and squared chin beneath a slanted beret. The beret has a small top stem, and a broad rounded shoulder outline closes beneath the neck.

concept: Standing Person Beside Seated Pointed Ear Pet
description: A front facing person stands beside a smaller seated pet with two pointed ears. Both figures have blank faces, and straight lower divisions separate the person's legs and the animal's front legs.

concept: Laptop Worker Beneath Sun and Horizon
description: A round headed person sits behind a slanted open laptop with a circular mark on its lid. A partial sun and short rays appear above a horizontal horizon line at the upper left.

concept: Voice Recorder with Round Speaker Area
description: An upright recorder has a rounded rectangular body with a large circular speaker area near the top. Two short horizontal lines sit below the circle on the otherwise blank front.

concept: Round Bread Loaf with Three Scores
description: A low rounded loaf of bread has a broad domed top and gently flattened base. Three short curved scoring cuts descend from the upper edge across the right half of the crust.

concept: Rowboat with Diagonal Oar Across Hull
description: A shallow rowboat rests on a wavy waterline, with raised ends and a gently dipping upper edge. One long oar crosses diagonally over the hull, placing its broad blade below the left side.

concept: Seated Person Beside Front Facing Car
description: A seated person appears at the lower left with a bent arm and forward angled legs. A separate front facing car sits above and to the right, showing its windshield and two short wheels.

concept: Dolman Top with Broad Short Sleeves
description: A short sleeved top faces forward with a shallow round neckline and broad sloping shoulders. Wide sleeves join the body through short inward seams above a gently curved lower hem.

concept: Cross with Long Vertical Stem
description: A straight vertical line intersects a shorter horizontal line near the center. The upper and lower stem extend beyond the side arms, forming a plain narrow cross with open ends.

concept: Diner Building with Broad Fascia and Dome
description: A small diner faces forward beneath a broad rounded fascia and a semicircular rooftop feature. A square window and tall doorway occupy its plain facade above a long horizontal ground line.

concept: Donkey Head with Tall Pointed Ears
description: A donkey head faces left with two tall pointed ears and a long rounded muzzle. A curved line separates the nose from the face, while the neck angles downward behind the jaw.

concept: Open Doorpost Frame with Inner Corner
description: A tall doorpost outline forms a squared top and long upright sides around an empty opening. An inset right angle follows the upper left corner, with the inner top line stopping short.

concept: Sleeveless V Neck Vest with Hem Band
description: A sleeveless vest has a deep V neckline and curved arm openings. A central seam descends from the neckline to a broad horizontal hem band above softly rounded lower corners.

concept: Sleeveless Dress with Wavy Skirt Hem
description: A sleeveless dress has a wide round neckline and a fitted bodice narrowing at a horizontal waist seam. Its skirt flares outward to a soft wavy hem across the bottom.

concept: Doghouse with Thick Gabled Roof
description: A small doghouse faces forward beneath a thick peaked roof with wide projecting eaves. A large arched doorway opens through the middle, leaving short rounded wall sections on either side.

concept: Two Leaf Sprout in Soil Mound
description: A slender sprout rises from the center of an uneven soil mound. Two large pointed leaves spread above the stem, while a few short scattered marks texture the rounded mound below.
